title: Malformed-plan suite
statement: The T020 candidate must add a malformed-plan suite that systematically injects structural and closed-shape defects and asserts the declared fail-closed outcome, stable code, affected identifier, and the absence of a decoded plan, as a distinct family from the T019 NEG-D* set.
verification_intent: CTest cases T20MalformedPlan.*; trusted unit measure.
acceptance_criteria: Every T20-MAL-* case asserts rejected or failed with its declared code and no plan.
